title: Hang in new project after using "Open Folder in Terminal"
body:
### Tested versions - Reproducable in: v4.5.1.stable.official [f62fdbde1] ### System information Godot v4.5.1.stable - Bazzite 43.20251210.0 (Kinoite) on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 7800 XT (RADV NAVI32) - AMD Ryzen 5 5600X 6-Core Processor (12 threads) - 15.53 GiB memory ### Issue description After clicking "Open Folder in Terminal", Godot hangs in a fresh, empty project. I have observed Godot crashing in a non-empty project too - this might be related, but I'm not reporting that yet.
